newsitem.title: USA: Natural gas line explodes in Los Angeles.
newsitem.headline: Natural gas line explodes in Los Angeles.

text.p: An underground natural gas line exploded near downtown Los Angeles late Friday, ripping up a 300-yard section of a street and injuring at least five people.
According to officials, the line exploded during routine tests conducted by a local utility.
One of the injured included a member of the work crew.
Local television and radio stations reported evacuations were underway and that one building may have sustained structural damage caused by flying shards, some the size of dining room tables.
The cause of the explosion is under investigation.
